title: Guangzhou Opera House / Zaha Hadid Architects
materials: алюминиевая кровельная система Kalzip со standing seam-оболочкой
summary_en: The Guangzhou Opera House is a 70,000 m² cultural complex on the Pearl River waterfront. Its twin-boulder composition is inspired by pebbles shaped by river erosion and developed as a faceted parametric envelope. The 1,800-seat main auditorium was designed with advanced acoustic engineering. The project became a major cultural anchor for Guangzhou's Zhujiang New Town district.

title: Guangzhou Circle / Joseph di Pasquale architect
summary_en: Guangzhou Circle is an 85,000 m² headquarters building for Guang Dong HongDa Xing. The 33-storey circular volume references the Chinese jade bi disc and local numerological symbolism while also drawing on Italian Renaissance compositional ideas. The structure was wind-tested at the Polytechnic of Milan. In profile, the building reads as two rows of volumetric blocks assembled into a single ring.

title: Chaoyang Park Plaza / MAD Architects
summary_en: Chaoyang Park Plaza is a 223,009 m² mixed-use development on the southern edge of Beijing's Chaoyang Park. The project reinterprets traditional Chinese landscape painting at urban scale, with two sinuous office towers, commercial pavilions, and residential volumes composed as mountains, rocks, and water. Curved dark facades and reflective surfaces strengthen the dialogue between park and city. The complex received LEED Gold certification.

title: Galaxy SOHO / Zaha Hadid Architects
summary_en: Galaxy SOHO is a large mixed-use office, retail, and entertainment complex in central Beijing. The project is composed of four continuous volumes linked by bridges and plateaus, forming a seamless internal urban landscape without sharp corners or abrupt transitions. Its flowing geometry reinterprets the Chinese courtyard through parametric continuity and layered circulation. The complex became one of the key built urban works of Zaha Hadid Architects in Beijing.

title: Beijing Daxing International Airport / Zaha Hadid Architects
summary_en: Beijing Daxing International Airport is a 700,000 m² passenger terminal and major regional transport hub. Its compact radial plan organizes five piers around a central court, minimizing passenger walking distances while integrating rail, metro, and road interchange below. Six large structural arms descend from the vaulted roof to the ground, bringing daylight deep into the terminal. The building translates infrastructural scale into a continuous parametric spatial system.
